fishing: WHEN: early/moving tides (solunar high ~6-8a & 6-8p). PASSES-BEACH: snook C&R, redfish, jacks Stump/Manasota. LEMON BAY: redfish schools, snook docks/shore, trout, mangrove snapper. NEARSHORE: mangrove/lane snapper, gag grouper. Baits: live shrimp, pinfish, threadfin, soft plastics.
redtide: FWC: K. brevis background in 1 Sarasota sample past week; not observed elsewhere SWFL.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD (~10 CFU); Charlotte sites clear.
